els.headline: How Chrome Incognito keeps your browsing private

sources.claim: Incognito doesn't retain site data or a record of visited sites; websites, and organizations that manage your network like your school, employer or internet service provider, can still see activity; downloads and bookmarks are kept

post.instagram_caption:
Incognito mode makes you anonymous online. Myth.

It only stops your own browser from keeping your history and cookies once you close the window. Google's own Chrome help page says the websites you visit can still see your activity, and so can whoever runs your network: your school, your employer or your internet provider.

Files you download and bookmarks you save are kept too.

The lesson: Incognito protects your device, not your identity online.

Source: Google Chrome Help, checked Nov 4, 2026.

Did you think Incognito hid you from your internet provider?
